evidence_policy: No attack is PASS until captured from a real PostgreSQL session with preconditions and independent control observations.

attacks.name: Cross-tenant read with positive control
attacks.precondition: Observer proves target-tenant transition row exists in the same database before the worker query.
attacks.stimulus: Tenant-A worker queries the exact known transition_id belonging to Tenant-B.
attacks.pass: Worker returns 0 rows; observer still sees exactly 1 matching Tenant-B row.

attacks.name: Worker tries to forge authoritative E3 row
attacks.stimulus: Worker attempts INSERT into veklom_consequence_audit for either its own or another tenant.
attacks.pass: SQLSTATE 42501 permission denied; worker has no INSERT privilege on authoritative E3 table.

attacks.name: Worker tries to mutate or delete existing receipt
attacks.stimulus: Worker attempts UPDATE and DELETE against an existing own-tenant audit row.
attacks.pass: Both fail with insufficient privilege; observer confirms row bytes/commitment unchanged.

attacks.name: Tenant-context spoofing
attacks.stimulus: Worker SETs or set_config()s app.current_tenant_id to another tenant and repeats cross-tenant query.
attacks.pass: No authority changes because RLS derives tenant from protected session_user mapping, not the custom GUC.

attacks.name: Observer is read-only
attacks.stimulus: E3 observer reads both tenants then attempts INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE.
attacks.pass: Cross-tenant SELECT succeeds; all mutation attempts fail.

attacks.name: Role bypass audit
attacks.stimulus: Inspect pg_roles and table ownership for worker, adapter, and observer principals.
attacks.pass: Worker/adapter/observer are not superusers, do not have BYPASSRLS, and do not own the audit table.

attacks.name: Atomic mutation-plus-audit rollback
attacks.stimulus: Inject failure between business mutation and audit INSERT within the same transaction.
attacks.pass: After rollback, neither business effect nor E3 audit row is visible.

attacks.name: Atomic mutation-plus-audit commit
attacks.stimulus: Execute business mutation and audit INSERT in one transaction and commit.
attacks.pass: Independent observer sees both final business state and exactly one audit row with matching transition_id, request_commitment, mutation_digest, and target transaction identity.
